deploymentEvidence.sourceType: official Resolv Ethereum deployment table, independently corroborated by exact-address proxy verification
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Smart Contracts table identifies the exact Ethereum wstUSR proxy and separately identifies the stUSR token. This is wstUSR, not the unrelated stRESOLV governance-token staking contract. Etherscan and Sourcify identify TransparentUpgradeableProxy and report the same applicable WstUSR implementation.
limitations: The constructor implementation differs from the implementation reported at review; the original ABI was not substituted for the reported current implementation ABI.

The proxy constructor initializer binds initial stUSR. The WstUSR initializer derives usrAddress from stUSR.underlyingToken(); the documentation mapping does not independently prove current stored dependencies or underlying-token configuration.

The supplied resolv-im/resolv-contracts-public GitHub repository lead returned HTTP 404. Official deployment documentation plus exact-address verified implementation source/ABI establish this binding without a generic repository ABI.
Source snapshots and proxy resolution are evidence-service observations, not a live storage/bytecode, liquidity, balances, collateral, successful execution or financial-safety attestation.

abiEvidence.sourceType: exact-address implementation ABI applied through independently reported proxy resolution
abiEvidence.evidence: Top-level abi is the full exact applicable WstUSR implementation ABI returned for the reported implementation address, including all 68 functions, 34 errors, 18 events and constructor. No generic ERC4626 ABI is substituted: verified IWstUSR explicitly extends IERC4626, while the actual WstUSR body separately implements USR deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem and rebasing-stUSR wrap/unwrap with overloaded convenience calls. proxyAbi preserves the full exact TransparentUpgradeableProxy ABI separately; it has no function entries.
abiEvidence.proxyAdministration: Verified TransparentUpgradeableProxy dispatches upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) only for its immutable ProxyAdmin caller through fallback. This implicit privileged dispatcher is not a WstUSR ABI function and is not selected; fallback/receive/constructor create no capabilities. No ProxyAdmin address is admitted.

reviewNotes.conversionModel: USR deposit/mint transfer the configured USR to this wrapper, call stUSR.deposit and mint wstUSR. USR withdraw/redeem call stUSR.withdraw and burn owner wstUSR. wrap transfers nominal rebasing stUSR and converts to shares/1000; unwrap burns wstUSR and transfers amount*1000 stUSR shares. This is not a fixed 1:1 conversion and the full ABI, not an assumed token standard, defines selected calls.
reviewNotes.readOnlyLimit: view/pure entries remain in the full ABI with mutability intact, but no read API or transaction capability is added. maxDeposit/maxMint return uint256 maximum in source, not proof of executable capacity.
reviewNotes.controlLimit: All initialization, access-control/admin, blacklist/confiscation, token approval/transfer and signature-permit surfaces are individually excluded. No opaque executor, callback or multicall function appears in this implementation ABI. No grant, policy, safety control or dependent-token capability is changed.
